findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms require you to wait three months to receive payment, which can severely strain your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello! Thank you for sharing the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to propose a quick adjustment to the relevant clause. - Regarding the relevant clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting three months to receive payment can strain cash flow, so I propose modifying it to: Invoices are payable Net 30. Best regards.
